The doctor is really friendly, I was able to communicate with him in English, the clinic is clean and neat.

Went there for the driver license health certificate. It was fast and fuss free.

Cost 200 baht 😊
Affordable fee for medical certificate for driving license. Clean environment and hospitable.
Medical certificate for driver licence - 100bht in 5min

I visited to get a health certificate required for a Thai driver's license. Both the guide and the doctor were friendly and nice. There's a Thai food court nearby, so parking is convenient. It cost 100 baht and took about 5 minutes. ^^
